title: · IN-BAG | Hermès Unveils Arctic-Inspired Lipsticks for Fall/Winter 2026 ·
original_title: IN-BAG | Hermès 即将发售2026秋冬限定系列唇膏：北极灵感
excerpt: Hermès launches Arctic-inspired lipsticks this September, featuring three shades in vibrant cases evoking glaciers and cabins.
author: 撰稿 X Vivi 编辑 X RAN

blocks.text: Hermès is set to release its limited-edition lip collection for Fall/Winter 2026 this September. Inspired by the colorful cabins and vast glaciers of the Arctic, the new lineup features three shades:**38 Rouge Airelle**, a glossy berry;**83 Rouge Scandinave**, a matte Nordic red; and**21 Rouge Épicé**, a satin terracotta. Each lipstick comes in a vibrant case that plays with warm and cool contrasts, capturing the essence of the polar landscape.

The limited-edition cases are designed by Pierre Hardy, Creative Director of Hermès' shoe and jewelry divisions. Set against a pristine white background, they feature a kaleidoscope of blues, reds, pinks, yellows, and greens, echoing the vibrant houses and snow-capped peaks of the Arctic tundra.**38 Rouge Airelle**is a glossy lipstick with a pinkish-red hue and a rich berry scent that evokes freshly picked fruit. Its lightweight, silky texture glides on like a delicate veil, leaving a luminous finish. Enriched with white mulberry extract and sesame seed oil, it nourishes and conditions the lips.

**83 Rouge Scandinave**is a deep Nordic red inspired by the wooden cabins of Scandinavia. This matte lipstick delivers a velvety, soft-focus finish with a warm, rich tone. The precision bullet tip allows for exact application, defining the lips with bold, saturated color and a polished look.

**21 Rouge Épicé**is a pink-toned lipstick with a terracotta twist, offering a subtle sheen that imparts a glossy, radiant finish. All lipsticks in the limited-edition collection feature refillable cases, and each cap is engraved with the brand's iconic signature motif.
